title: Separable elements are dense in the spectral algebraic closure
statement: Let $K$ be a field [def-weil-field], complete for a nontrivial real-valued multiplicative nonarchimedean absolute value, and let $\Omega/K$ be an algebraic closure [def-weil-algebraic-closure]. Equip $\Omega$ with the spectral absolute value $s_{\Omega/K}$ [lem-trf-spectral-norm-algebraic-extension]. Let $K_s\subseteq\Omega$ be the subfield of elements separable algebraic over $K$ [def-weil-pbc-relative-separable-closure]. Then $K_s$ is dense in $\Omega$: for every $x\in\Omega$ and every real $r>0$ there exists $y\in K_s$ with $s_{\Omega/K}(x-y)<r$.
